caseName: Painters' District Council No. 22, Brotherhood of Painters, Decorators & Paperhangers v. Austin
caseNameFull: Painters' District Council No. 22, Brotherhood of Painters, Decorators & Paperhangers of America (A. F. L.) v. Austin

opinions.text:
Appeal from

the Supreme Court of Michigan.

Per Curiam:

The appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction. 28 U. S. C. § 1257 (2). Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, as required by 28 U. S. C. § 2103, certiorari is denied.
